cacheBenefitWithinBaselineImage.attribution: Same baseline image, cache disabled versus enabled; do not attribute this whole difference to the later optimization.
cacheBenefitWithinBaselineImage.note: Positive reduction means lower; negative means higher. Successful-response means exclude failures/drops, which remain explicit. No statistical significance or production capacity is asserted.

incrementalOptimization.attribution: Baseline cache-enabled image versus optimized cache-enabled image at matching recorded controls.
incrementalOptimization.note: Positive reduction means lower; negative means higher. Successful-response means exclude failures/drops, which remain explicit. No statistical significance or production capacity is asserted.

warmup.note: Warmup was a separately declared phase. All warmup failures and drops are retained in each case and these totals; they are not a healthy cold-start claim.

limitations: All scheduled measured cases were included; warmup/prefill stay outside measured request statistics.
Latency averages are weighted by successful correct responses; errors and drops are retained separately.
Median of run p95 values is not a pooled p95 and does not prove statistical significance.
These local results share a host for generator and services; they do not establish production capacity.
Observed cache hits/misses count cache-get calls. A leader recheck may make more than one call per HTTP request; HTTP sources are reported separately.
